description: Everything for one subject: every result column (tests, assignments, period and report averages, SE averages) with weights and remarks, column definitions (also not-yet-graded ones), and the parts of composite tests. Both progress and exam dossier unless dossier is set. Without vak: the list of subjects. Use this to drill into one subject; use grades_overview for all subjects at once.

dossier.description: voortgang = progress dossier, examen = school-exam (SE) dossier. Default both.

leerlingId.description: Numeric leerling id. Required when more than one child is linked.
